description: An accepted inception, then an interaction whose d is not the digest of its body, signed by the current key. Verifying an event's structure includes its SAID (line 1737), so a validator must not accept the interaction. Built on keripy 1.x's wire: KERI 1.0 bodies with keripy 1.x's field sets and CESR 1.00 attachments, mirroring KERI-0011 (KS-17) in keri-v1.0.1.
title: keripy 1.x: interaction whose SAID does not match its content
